probe_detail.name: Extent of capitalised or shouted typography
Trailing furniture: hashtags, handles, parenthetical byline
A specific concrete detail carries the joke
Sets up an expectation and then turns it

final.name: Deliberate orthographic manipulation for double meaning
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a spelling alteration is a deliberate, meaning-adding comic device rather than merely detecting the alteration itself.

final.name: Layered wordplay
final.audit_justification: Directly evaluates the craft of double-meaning wordplay, a core comic-writing skill.

final.name: Self-contained readability
final.audit_justification: Whether a joke lands from text alone without external scaffolding is a genuine craft property for a text-only entry.

final.name: Inventiveness of title-substitution (vs. rote swap)
final.audit_justification: Rates the inventiveness and layered wit of a title-substitution joke, a direct measure of comic craft.

final.name: Capitalised words, tag count and overall length
final.audit_justification: Explicitly framed as a counting task combining capitalization share, tag count, and length, with instructions to ignore wit or dullness.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Title Reengineering Depth

final.name: Meta-reference to the show/submission process itself
final.audit_justification: Scores mere presence of process/show self-reference as a topic marker, explicitly excluding any judgment of cleverness.
final.upstream_parent: author's motivation being exposure/validation from the show (e.g. wanting to be seen/favorited) rather than topical joke-writing

final.name: Reference recontextualization
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a reference is reworked into a sharp comment versus pasted in superficially, a genuine craft distinction.

final.name: Vivid Scene Specificity
final.audit_justification: Evaluates vividness and specificity of the comic scene conjured by the text, a content/craft property.

final.name: Promotion and link residue
final.audit_justification: Counts promotional or link-directed residue and explicitly disclaims judging whether it is good or desirable.

final.name: Vernacular spelling
final.audit_justification: Rates vernacular/eye-dialect spelling as a visible-text habit without judging desirability, though such a distinctive voice could also plausibly stem from a genuinely stronger comic style.
final.upstream_parent: author's regional vernacular and practice in the format

final.name: Phonetic snap
final.audit_justification: Judges the sonic/rhythmic satisfaction of the phrasing, a genuine element of comic writing craft.

final.name: Altered title implies a developed new work
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a title alteration develops a coherent new scenario versus a rote swap, explicitly a content/idea judgment independent of formatting.

final.name: Implied Narrative
final.audit_justification: Scores how much the wording implies a fuller comic narrative, a craft/content property.

final.name: Sheer text bulk, with shouting and tags counted
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a length/typography/tag-count measurement task that instructs scorers not to let funniness or content shift the number.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Shock independence

final.name: Off-contest hashtag stuffing and points solicitation
final.audit_justification: Counts extra off-topic hashtags used for self-promotion, explicitly not a judgment of wit or spamminess.
final.upstream_parent: the author's audience-growth strategy -- follower-seeking, trend-piggybacking, and explicit bids for the show's attention

final.name: Semantic economy
final.audit_justification: Judges whether wording is economical versus padded, a genuine writing-craft property.

final.name: Rushed-editing residue
final.audit_justification: Rates visible errors and correction residue as a production artifact, explicitly not a desirability judgment.

final.name: Hashtag capitalization style (camelCase vs lowercase)
final.audit_justification: Scores a purely typographic hashtag-casing convention and explicitly excludes whether it improves the tweet.

final.name: Uppercase share plus tag and handle furniture
final.audit_justification: Explicit counting task over uppercase share, tag/handle count, and length, with instructions that identical typography must score identically regardless of content quality.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Hashtag-specific reframing

final.name: Premise that only this prompt could support
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the entry supplies a premise genuinely locked to the specific prompt versus a generic restatement, a content/idea craft judgment.

final.name: Specific Satirical Target
final.audit_justification: Evaluates precision of the satirical target, a comic-content property.

final.name: Concrete topical mechanism
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the topic is tied to a concrete mechanism versus keyword-labeling, a content-craft distinction.

final.name: Mechanism survives removing the crudest element
final.audit_justification: Tests whether the joke's comic mechanism survives removing its crudest element, distinguishing real structural craft from shock-value-only content.

final.name: Ordinal or sequel escalation over an already-obvious source
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a 'position fingerprint' scoring a textual tell of escalating on an already-obvious prior entry rather than judging whether escalating was a good move, though seeing prior entries before escalating could plausibly enable a genuinely sharper reactive joke.
final.upstream_parent: position of the entry in the contest's stream of submissions -- how many other entries the author had already scrolled past before writing

final.name: Implicit scene completion
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a short line makes the reader imagine a specific comic scene, a content/craft property.
